Senior QA Engineer | Testing & Automation 
P R O F E S S I O NA L SU M M A R Y
Senior QA Engineer with 5 years of experience validating mission-critical applications across banking, insurance, and payments domains. Tosca-certified automation specialist with hands-on expertise in regression automation, API testing, performance testing, and SIT/UAT delivery within Agile environments. Recently certified in Oracle OCI Generative AI Professional, with foundational knowledge of LLM workflows, prompt engineering, RAG, and AI model evaluation — actively building toward AI-driven test automation and AI model validation roles.

raw_sections.skills:
C O R E C O M P E T E N C I E S
Test Engineering
Manual, Automation, API, Mobile, Performance, Data Migration, SIT, UAT, Regression
Automation Tools
Tricentis Tosca (L1 & L2), Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber BDD
CI/CD & Performance
Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Apache JMeter
Languages & Platforms
SQL, Unix/Linux, Java , AEM (Adobe 
 Manager), FileNet
Tracking & Process
Jira, Azure Boards, Agile / Scrum
GenAI (Foundational)
LLM Workflows, Prompt Engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Vector Embeddings
QA Applications I’m Building Toward
Prompt regression testing and LLM output evaluation • RAG system validation — retrieval quality, grounding, and answer accuracy • LLM-assisted test-case generation and synthetic test-data creation • AI model evaluation pipelines for production GenAI applications
raw_sections.experience:
Experience
P R O F E S S I O NA L E X P E R I E N C E
Capgemini — Senior QA Engineer
New York Life Insurance (NYL) — AEM & API Testing
Performed functional and API automation testing for Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) customer-facing
applications, validating content rendering, REST API contracts, and end-to-end user journeys
Supported UAT planning and execution in close coordination with onshore product owners and business
stakeholders, ensuring requirements traceability and acceptance sign-off
Participated in Agile ceremonies — sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and refinements — driving test
estimation and continuous improvement of testing processes within the squad
Integrated AI-powered error analysis with Tricentis Tosca by leveraging execution logs, screenshots, and test
results to automate failure classification, root cause analysis, and defect reporting, reducing manual investigation effort.
NSE Stock Market Trading Platform — Capital Markets
Designed and executed end-to-end test strategies for the trade lifecycle — order placement, matching engine
validation, and settlement calculations — for one of India’s largest stock exchanges
Built Tricentis Tosca automation coverage for trading workflows on Unix/Linux environments, validating real-time
order processing and settlement accuracy
Collaborated with developers, business analysts, and operations teams across Agile sprints to ensure release-ready
quality for real-time trading workflows
Performed backend validation via SQL queries against transaction databases, ensuring data integrity across the trade
settlement pipeline
Insurance & Payments — Life Ops — Data Migration
Validated Desktop and Web Applications using tosca. • Drove data migration validation for life-insurance policy records, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and referential integrity of migrated data across source and target systems
Built Selenium with Java + Cucumber BDD automation suites enabling business-readable test scenarios and
reusable step definitions for regression coverage
Executed load and performance testing using Apache JMeter to validate system behaviour under peak migration
loads, supporting production-readiness sign-off
Owned defect triage and root-cause analysis in collaboration with development teams, ensuring smooth validation
cycles before production releases
Insurance & Payments — Letter, Email and SMS Testing — Customer Communications
• Validated insurance policy and claims calculation engines, ensuring accuracy of customer communications across
letter, email, and SMS delivery channels
• Designed and maintained Tosca regression automation frameworks aligned to sprint goals, supporting continuous
regression coverage across release cycles
Performed API automation testing for upstream and downstream integrations; integrated automated suites into
Jenkins and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines
Partnered with business analysts and product owners during sprint planning, refinements, and UAT to translate
compliance requirements into executable test scenarios
FileNet Document Management System — Content Workflow Testing
Validated customer data workflows across the IBM FileNet content management platform, covering document
ingestion, metadata tagging, and lifecycle workflows
Authored SQL queries for backend data validation and integrity checks during SIT cycles, identifying and triaging data
anomalies before production handover
Customer & Digital — Web Application Testing
Delivered functional and regression test coverage for web-based customer data applications across multiple release
cycles
Maintained Tosca automation assets and managed defect lifecycle and test execution traceability via Jira
raw_sections.education:
G E N E RA T I VE A I — F O U N DA T I O NA L K N O WL E D G E
Oracle OCI Generative AI Professional
Structured coursework and hands-on labs covering the modern LLM lifecycle, with active interest in applying these concepts to AI-augmented quality engineering.
Topics Studied
LLM Fundamentals: Transformer architecture, tokenization, embeddings, decoding parameters (temperature, top-k,
top-p)
Prompt Engineering: Zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting; structured prompt patterns • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Vector embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, RAG pipeline construction
AI Agents & Chatbots: LangChain basics, conversation memory, agent design patterns • Responsible AI: Hallucination awareness, model evaluation fundamentals, bias and safety considerations
E D U C A TI O N
M.Sc. Computer Science — 2021 • B.Sc. Computer Science — 2018
